sloka: अल्प वीर्या यदा यक्षी श्रूयते मुनिपुङ्गव ।कथम् नाग सहस्रस्य धारयति अबला बलम् ॥१-२५-२॥
transliteration: alpa vīryā yadā yakṣī śrūyate munipuṅgava ।katham nāga sahasrasya dhārayati abalā balam ॥1-25-2॥

translations.english: "O best of ascetics, I have heard the yakshas possess little prowess. How can a woman who is by gender weak possess the strength of a thousand elephants?
